in_marathi.name: Puia
in_marathi.long_meaning: Puia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Puia is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pushpa' meaning 'flower'. The name Puia is associated with the jasmine flower and symbolizes love, beauty, and purity. In Hinduism, the jasmine flower is considered sacred and is often used in religious ceremonies and offerings to the gods.
